parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of records to return in this request.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token. If there is a next page, this field has a return value. As long as this parameter returns data, there is a next page. You can use the returned NextToken as a request parameter to retrieve the next page of data until the return value is Null, which indicates that all data has been retrieved.
